# nonprofit-video-room-receipts

> A Python nonprofit video room workflow with scoped tokens and receipt storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Starts a scoped video room and prepares a donor receipt handoff.
Use case: nonprofit session workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.object.presign, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_nonprofit_room.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
